content.text: Most tutorials about building a digital store focus on the storefront. The storefront is the last thing you should configure. The backend is what makes the store work — and the backend is what most creators get wrong when they try to build without a clear sequence. In Stack 01, Google Apps Script serves as the backend Web App — it receives the NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s webhook, validates the signature, confirms the transaction on-chain, logs the order to Google Sheets, and sends the delivery email via Gmail. In Stack 02, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-7|Cloudflare R2]]-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-7|cloudflare]] Workers replaces Apps Script with a faster, more scalable serverless backend that integrates natively with Supabase for order storage and Resend for email delivery. Configure the backend first, set the webhook endpoint URL in NOWPayments second, build the storefront third, and test on mainnet fourth.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Conventional payment platforms often exclude creators in developing regions due to regulatory limitations. COREMERCH’s architecture empowers you to build a digital store that operates independently of such constraints. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, you gain sovereignty over your commerce stack. This means you can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies without facing the hurdles that traditional platforms impose, ensuring continuous access to your revenue streams.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before starting the deployment, ensure you have the necessary accounts and access in place. Create a Cloudflare account for hosting your site, which is free, and set up a Google account for Apps Script. Familiarize yourself with Supabase for order storage, as it will play a crucial role in managing your transactions. Lastly, prepare your digital products for upload, ensuring they meet your customers' needs. This preparation will streamline the deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your Cloudflare Pages setup. Deploy your static site to Cloudflare and integrate your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers. Next, set up Supabase to store your order information. Once this pipeline is established, configure NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This step is vital as it enables automatic payment processing with minimal fees. Ensure product files are stored in a reliable location like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for seamless delivery to customers.
Your digital store can thrive without reliance on traditional payment platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After deploying your infrastructure, it’s time to go live. Test your setup in the mainnet environment to ensure everything functions correctly. Start by processing a test transaction through NOWPayments. Monitor the payment confirmation processes closely to guarantee that the webhook integration triggers correctly. Once you confirm that transactions are processed without issues, promote your store to your audience. Utilize social media and other channels to drive traffic to your site.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store operational, consider strategies for scaling. Explore the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for enhanced features, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations for better email deliverability. Regularly evaluate your product offerings and adjust based on customer feedback. You can also expand your product range to include more digital assets. Continuous engagement with your audience will foster community and loyalty, driving sales growth in the long term.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can use Cloudflare Pages along with NOWPayments. This combination allows you to set up a fully operational store without relying on conventional payment platforms that may not serve your region. The entire process is designed for efficiency and sovereignty.
You own every aspect of your infrastructure, ensuring complete sovereignty.

For those interested in advanced features and faster deployment, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) as an alternative. This stack offers a comprehensive setup with enhanced support, ensuring you can scale your digital store effectively. For more information on products, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a Cloudflare account for hosting. Set up a Google account for Apps Script integration. Prepare your digital products for upload. Deploy your static site to Cloudflare Pages. Configure Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Set up Supabase for order management. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payments. Store product files in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test your setup in the mainnet environment. Promote your store to attract customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long does it take to deploy Stack 01?
Stack 01 takes approximately 4-6 hours to deploy when following the Sovereign Blueprint. This timeline allows for a rapid setup, enabling you to start selling your digital products quickly.
What are the benefits of using Cloudflare Pages?

Cloudflare Pages offers fast and secure hosting for your digital store. Its integration with Workers allows you to manage backend logic seamlessly, creating a powerful and efficient infrastructure for processing transactions.
Can I use GitHub Pages instead of Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, you can host your digital store on GitHub Pages. However, Stack 02 with Cloudflare Pages is recommended for enhanced performance and scalability with features like Workers and Supabase.
Will I be charged fees for using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a minimal fee of 0.5% per transaction. This fee applies only when a payment is successfully processed, making it a cost-effective solution for accepting crypto payments.
What happens after I deploy my store?
Once your store is deployed, you can begin processing transactions immediately. Monitor performance and customer feedback to optimize your offerings and scale your business effectively.
